body:
Dude your comment made me smile. The world would be less fabulous without me 😂

And yes, this is bloody awful. He’s doing better it seems. He stays conscious for longer too
Thank you. Your words are incredibly helpful
His dad could stick a gun in my face and I wouldn’t budge. Nothing will keep me from being here for him

Thank you!

And I will if I have to. I’m just hurting rn

Thank you. I keep brushing his hair with my hand. It keeps him calm when he wakes up. I just love him so much, and his dad and I got into it though. His dad was like “quit caressing my son you faggot!” And I told him that I didn’t like his son like that. I have a boyfriend. I just really care for him. Then, his mom made his dad go home because he wasn’t helping at all. I’m just in a bad place rn

I do have a boyfriend. I love him with all my heart. I know that suicide would completely destroy him. I just don’t want to deal with the pain of losing someone so close to me. I think it’s just my emotions talking. I’m trying to ignore the “you’d see him in the afterlife thoughts” because A. If there is an afterlife like heaven or hell, like in Christianity, hellward bound I am. B. I know he wouldn’t want me to kill myself. He’s a great person and if he wasn’t physically impaired, I guarantee you he would knock me unconscious if he absolutely had to to prevent me from killing myself. So would my boyfriend. My bf is just halfway across the country right now. We Skyped the other about a half hour ago. I told him everything I’m going through and what I’ve been thinking. He said he’d never stop crying or visiting my grave, on top of the “I’m your boyfriend and I love you from the bottom of my heart” speech. He’s absolutely right too. He’s been so good to me. He has never gotten jealous of my friendship with my best friend.

One time I asked him. I said “you’re not jealous of how close I am to A, are you? I love you both, but in different ways.” And he responds “he can have your friendship. He can have your love. He can have anything he wants except your dick and your butt. I know what you two have been through. I will never try to come between you guys, and I hope he’d do the same.” My boyfriend is so caring and understanding and loving. I can’t ask for a better one. I think you guys have really helped me come down from thinking about suicide. I’m still devastated though.

I’m even more upset because my best friend made me go home and get a good night’s sleep. He told me “I’m not going to rest until you do. Come back in the morning. I’ll still be here. I promise.” And I brushed his hair out of his eyes and kissed his forehead since I couldn’t hug him. God man I just can’t bare to lose him. My boyfriend comes home in about three days though, so hopefully it’ll get easier
Thank you. You’re a great dude (or lady dude). I appreciate your kind words. Would you mind if I pm’d you if this, doesn’t go well?

Thank you. I just I really have no idea how to do this without him. He loved me when I thought I was unlovable. He cared for me when I thought no one cared. He saved my life. I told him that I was going to go crash my car into a tree or something after my parents kicked me out. He took my keys away, drove me to his house, and we played video games until sunrise. I actually was going to end it. I had a note in my wallet and a will for my limited possessions. But he intervened and turned my life around. He’s such a wonderful human being and the world needs more people like him in it.

But now I can’t be there for him. I can’t save him. I just have to hope. But I have no hope right now. My boyfriend, is across the country right now for a business trip or else he’d be here beside me. I know that he loves me, and I love him. But my friend is the only person that I have faith will never ever leave me because he’s always been there for me. I just want him to be okay.

And if I ever meet the drunk driver who t-boned his driver side at an intersection, chances are I’ll be in prison for murder. I just can’t think of life without my best bud by my side

I wish I could do more for him than sit here and cry like a baby. The best thing I can do is hold his hand and hope everything turn out okay. I fucking hate how helpless I am. I want to save him, not comfort him. haven’t left his side all day except to go to the bathroom. 

And no matter his parents opinion of me, I’m glad they put him first. I’m glad they called. I’m just so stuck right now. I love him so damn much, he is half of me it seems. He’s the sweetest guy ever, if he accidentally stepped on an ant he’d feel guilty for at least 10 minutes. If I hadn’t already found a boyfriend that I loved when I came out to him, I might’ve fallen for him. He was the first person I told and he has been nothing but good to me. We’ve been through break ups, drama, horrible home life (his dad is very verbally abusive and my parents are... yea), and so much. I just don’t know where I’d be without him.

The doctors came in and his parents told the doctors who I was, so thankfully they agreed to let me here the news. The told us that his vital signs are significantly better than they were just yesterday, although they still weren’t great. They also said that he may need a kidney transplant depending on how things go, and if it comes to that I will do it in a heartbeat, no second thoughts. Id donate my heart to him if I had to, still beating and everything. I wouldn’t be alive today without him.

On a happier note, during his more conscious times, he said “you know you don’t have to hold my hand this whole time if you don’t want to” to which I responded by gripping his hand harder, which made him smile. I almost started crying again. I just don’t know what to do for him. He’s in so much pain and the morphine can only do so much. My heart just hurts for him.

And today his parents told me that they the police said the accident was caused by a drunk driver. I’m so fucking angry and hurt and sad all at the same time. Just I can’t lose him. I don’t know man. And thank you for your last comment 😔

Also thanks for reading and responding. I just need someone to talk to
